summary: Compositing and layers gained several reliability and security improvements, including stricter validation of scroll data and texture descriptors, limiting capture requests to the root WebRender bridge, and making dummy textures readable under memory pressure. Texture and buffer recycling was expanded for WebGL and WebGPU on Linux and Android, while synchronization fences and remote image color metadata improve graphics stability and color accuracy. The work also updates overscroll-behavior to support the standard “chain” value, brings timeline behavior closer to specification, and fixes HDR video rendering and platform-specific issues on Windows and Wayland.
